title: Exists parent_sizes cache poisoning — OR(simple, EXISTS) with empty children
description: Trigger shape for B2: a row that matches a simple OR-branch but has zero children for the EXISTS-OR-branch. Rust's `parent_sizes.insert(pk, children.len().max(1))` poisons the cache to store 1 instead of 0. Subsequent push transitions miss the 0→1 boundary or, combined with AUDIT-04 flip path, leave a stale row in output when the real count is 0. Mutation: add a child row to the empty parent — TS emits an Add transition, RS misses it.

spec_source.ts_lines: Push semantics — pure FilterOperator consults real Join relationship contents

wave1_action: After B2 fix lands (.max(1) removed), re-run with mutation block adding a child to an empty parent; assert TS and RS emit identical Add transition.
